description.content: Retrieve, filter, and manage security alerts generated by Varonis DatAlert threat detection engine.

Retrieves alerts from Varonis DatAlert based on specified filter criteria. Supports filtering by threat model name, time range, alert status, severity, device name, and user name. Returns comprehensive alert data including severity, category, status, user details, device information, and asset paths.
